newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEEK MIXED AGAINST UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEEK MIXED AGAINST UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed the week on Friday quietly easier on the U.S. dollar and the rand but was quoted firmer against European currencies, tracking a stronger U.S. unit overseas, dealers said.
"Nothing much was happening (on the local interbank market). There were virtually no deals recorded today," one dealer commented .

He said the Zimbabwe dollar finished at 10.8659/8800 on the U.S. dollar, where it opened earlier on, but this was a half cent drop from Thursday's closing position. It also eased to 2.3400/3500 from 2.3300/3360 versus neighbouring South Africa's rand.

Against sterling, the Zimbabwe dollar ended the week at 18.1800/2300, up from Thursday's 18.2020/2420 and also gained to 6.7700/7900 from 6.8110/8240 on the mark. --Stella Mapenzauswa, Harare Newsroom: +263-4 72 52 28/9--
